name: France
intro: Unlock the home of haute couture, fine vintage vineyards, and legendary art. From the historic avenues of Paris to the lavender hills of Provence, France is the ultimate cultural voyage.
bestSeason: April to June (Springtime) & September to October (Grape harvest)
weather: Temperate maritime climate. Pleasant warm summers (20°C to 28°C), cool winters (3°C to 8°C) with regular rainfall.
visaInfo: Schengen Visa required for Indian passport holders.
flightDuration: Approx 8-9 hours direct flight from New Delhi or Mumbai.
highlights: Marvel at the Eiffel Tower from a private Seine cruise
Enjoy after-hours private access to the masterpieces in the Louvre Museum
Tour historic wine cellars and vineyards in Reims and Bordeaux
Stay in converted 17th-century royal chateaux in the Loire Valley
